claim: IFEvalCode decouples code evaluation into Correctness and Instruction-Following axes, finding a significant gap between models' functional correctness and their adherence to explicit style/structural constraints.
stance_target: Multi-dimensional code evaluation beyond a single pass/fail score
scope_conditions: 1.6K test samples, 7 programming languages, EN+ZH queries, 40+ LLMs evaluated
quoted_support: Unlike existing benchmarks, IFEvalCode decouples evaluation into two metrics: correctness (Corr.) and instruction-following (Instr.), enabling a more nuanced assessment.
